notes: Bench gate track: A3-around-the-column start-pose override. The default start is 0.1 mm from the column (x 0.16..0.22, |y| < 0.03), inside the gate's 13 mm margin. From it the search reports a violation in one step, and simply holding the start pose (the gate allows it) puts the tool 2.6 mm into the column under servo sag; with ideal servos it stays 0.1 mm outside. That is the start state, not a gate decision. The task starts at the left tray, so the arm starts on the left side.
